subject.title: fix(agents): preserve tabs and newlines in prompt literal sanitization

question: Should framed untrusted prompt-data blocks preserve horizontal tabs while all inline prompt literals continue stripping them?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally strip every control character, so accepting U+0009 is a security-boundary contract change even when confined to an escaped, line-framed data block.

options.title: Preserve tabs only in framed blocks
options.body: Add a block-specific sanitizer after newline splitting so code indentation survives without changing inline workspace, session, steering, or approval literals.

options.title: Keep stripping tabs everywhere
options.body: Retain the current intentionally lossy security contract and close the linked fidelity request as unsupported.

options.title: Permit tabs globally
options.body: Change every sanitizer caller only after caller-by-caller safety review and explicit acceptance of the broader prompt contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve tabs only in framed blocks
recommendation.body: Add a block-specific sanitizer after newline splitting so code indentation survives without changing inline workspace, session, steering, or approval literals.

likelyOwner.reason: The original strict sanitizer, threat model, and tab-stripping regression contract were introduced in this person's commit.
